items.description: Confirm the current branch and announce it to the user before making changes.
items.evidence: Development2 announced before release edits; full GitHub deployment requested by Charles Scharlau on 2026-09-07.

items.description: Confirm the working tree is clean or existing changes are intentionally excluded from release work.
items.evidence: Release preparation began from clean Development2 at c2bd678; KiCad preference change had been reverted. Only release notes and checklist metadata were changed.

items.description: Increment the firmware patch version from the latest origin release and confirm the candidate tag does not already exist.
items.evidence: Origin latest release v2.0.3; v2.0.4 was unused and is the exact next patch.

items.description: Confirm local semantic release tags match origin without moving any published tag.
items.evidence: All local semantic release tag object IDs matched origin; no remote tag was changed.

items.description: Confirm the intended firmware version in SignalSlinger/defs.h and matching repo-root README asset references.
items.evidence: SW_REVISION and both README update assets use 2.0.4.

items.description: Decide the release channel for main or Development2.
items.evidence: Stable release on main requested as a full GitHub deployment; field-test limitations are explicit in the release notes.

items.description: Freeze and record the exact clean source commit used for release builds.
items.evidence: Exact clean integrated main source 859bad61c081bf4c450c3e8b5dc310ac6258bae6 was pushed before the full final release-preflight and package builds.

items.description: Prepare release integration in a clean worktree so unrelated local changes cannot enter the release.
items.evidence: Repository helper created /private/tmp/SignalSlinger-release-v2.0.4 on main and staged the renormalized merge. No conflicts, no KiCad changes, and staged firmware/README are byte-identical to Development2.

items.description: Run just check and just secrets at the frozen source commit.
items.evidence: Complete just release-preflight passed again from clean main 859bad61c081bf4c450c3e8b5dc310ac6258bae6: repository policy, script checks, thermal/session tests, production journal/runtime tests, version checks and full-history secret scan.

items.description: Run the normal, relocated, and bootloader repeatability checks with pinned tools and zero warnings.
items.evidence: Final main release-preflight passed: both normal and 0x2000 relocated hardware profiles repeated with seven byte-identical artifacts and zero warnings; bootloader repeated with five byte-identical artifacts and zero warnings; complete packages repeated identically.

items.description: Generate both hardware-specific release packages, manifests, checksums, READMEs, and ZIP archives.
items.evidence: Both final hardware packages contain ten files, including manifests, checksums, READMEs, update/first-install/setup HEX and ZIPs. Manifests report sourceTreeDirty=false, reference-version-match, and exact main source 859bad61c081bf4c450c3e8b5dc310ac6258bae6.

items.description: Independently validate package contents, hashes, ZIP members, and flash geometry.
items.evidence: Final main packages independently validated for hashes, ZIP members and flash geometry; ten byte-identical package files per target on repeated generation. HW-3.4 ZIP SHA256 9cf7656e2bac3589bd6969855c779f5df6faeff61c46b8305eab2e3768e17db8; HW-3.5 ZIP SHA256 ed34d09b3a79fdc5b2e06cc2b94b9c4423ae27ae8b68eab8247087814cc5cddf

items.description: Complete representative hardware programming, update, recovery, and version-report checks.
items.skipReason: On 2026-09-07 Charles explicitly approved publishing for Joseph field testing while recording representative HW-3.4/HW-3.5 programming, serial update, interrupted-update recovery and hardware rollback as untested.

items.description: Install each hardware build on a representative unit and capture its INF version report.
items.skipReason: On 2026-09-07 Charles explicitly approved the field-test release without physical installation and live INF version reports on representative HW-3.4/HW-3.5 units.

items.description: Select and verify the prior release package and documented recovery path.
items.evidence: Freshly downloaded v2.0.3 HW-3.4 and HW-3.5 ZIPs independently validated: hashes, ZIP contents and flash geometry pass; standalone update HEX files match ZIP members. Packaged READMEs provide normal-update and recovery procedures. Actual hardware rollback remains untested.

items.description: Document the salient user-observable changes since the previous release in the checked release-notes file.
items.evidence: Checked v2.0.4 notes document enabled 65 C default, configurable threshold, same-session thermal recovery, retained later days, and paired SerialSlinger 2.0.20 installation and field-test instructions.

items.description: Document significant stability and reliability improvements since the previous release in the checked release-notes file.
items.evidence: Checked notes describe EEPROM migration and journal integrity, stale-sensor RF interlock, honest interrupted/expired history, and explicit physical-test limitations.

items.description: On Development2, leave changes uncommitted unless the user explicitly asks for a commit.
items.evidence: Charles Scharlau explicitly authorized commit and push of all open non-KiCad work, followed by full GitHub deployment.

items.description: Obtain explicit approval to integrate the release candidate into main.
items.evidence: Charles Scharlau requested full deployment on GitHub on 2026-09-07; this authorizes standard integration into main.

items.description: Re-run release-preflight from the clean integrated main commit.
items.evidence: Clean main 859bad61c081bf4c450c3e8b5dc310ac6258bae6 matches origin/main and passed complete release-preflight. Its firmware and README match the reviewed Development2 candidate exactly.

items.description: Obtain explicit approval for the release tag and GitHub publication.
items.evidence: Charles requested full GitHub deployment and explicitly approved proceeding with the recorded physical-hardware validation waiver on 2026-09-07.

items.description: Create and push an annotated release tag at the verified commit.
items.evidence: Annotated v2.0.4 was pushed and its remote peeled target verified as exact clean package-build commit 859bad61c081bf4c450c3e8b5dc310ac6258bae6. The tag remains fixed.

items.description: Create the GitHub release using --notes-file with the checked release notes and the requested prerelease or normal release channel.
items.evidence: Published non-draft, non-prerelease https://github.com/OpenARDF/SignalSlinger/releases/tag/v2.0.4 using the checked release-notes file. Physical testing limitations remain explicit.

items.description: Upload both hardware assets to the release.
items.evidence: All four assets uploaded: HW-3.4 and HW-3.5 update HEX files and matching complete release ZIPs.

items.description: Verify the remote release body matches the checked notes file, both required change sections remain present, all assets are downloadable, and branch README targets are correct.
items.evidence: Fresh unauthenticated curl downloads of all four assets exactly matched local release files. Extracted public ZIPs passed independent checksums, ZIP membership and flash geometry validation; both manifests name 859bad61c081bf4c450c3e8b5dc310ac6258bae6 with sourceTreeDirty=false and reference-version-match. Remote annotated tag targets that commit. Published notes exactly match the checked file. Both branch README source versions reference v2.0.4 assets.
